hypotheses.title: Net Liquid Working Capital Shield & Analyst Sales Surprise Momentum (Decay 6, Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms maintaining high net liquid buffers ((cash_st - debt_st) / assets) possess structural defense against interest rate shocks and refinancing stress. Pairing this balance sheet liquidity with quarterly sales surprise momentum ((actual_sales - ts_mean(actual_sales, 252)) / ts_std_dev) captures solvent compounders experiencing institutional revenue expectation upgrades. Subindustry neutralization removes market beta, while quarterly accounting updates lock daily turnover at ~9.5%, targeting Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Idle cash hoard indicating management's inability to deploy capital profitably
Quarterly sales acceleration driven by temporary discounts squeezing gross margins
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during speculative junk-rallies where cash-poor, distressed companies violently short-squeeze.

hypotheses.title: Cashflow Efficiency Multi-Factor Derivative & Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope (Decay 6, Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Model16 cashflow efficiency rank derivative measures operating profitability and cash generation relative to invested capital across 100% of US equities. Pairing this operational moat with option8 volatility term structure slope ((iv_90 - iv_30) / iv_30) captures calm contango regimes where institutions anticipate stability and continuous multiple expansion. Low correlation (0.43) against the approved portfolio and 11% turnover drive elite Fitness.
confounders: Earnings announcement dates distorting 30-day implied volatility surface
Accounting revisions lagging sudden operational cash flow deterioration
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during sudden systemic volatility spikes where the entire options volatility term structure inverts into backwardation.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Shock Spillover & Defensive Low-Beta Anomaly (Decay 6, Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Economic information propagates with friction along corporate supply chains: customer return shocks (pv13_custretsig_retsig) take 3-5 days to be priced into supplier shares due to limited investor attention. Conditioning customer momentum with intra-subindustry defensive low-beta positioning (-beta_last_60_days_spy) isolates resilient suppliers with pricing power, generating high risk-adjusted returns orthogonal to fundamental yield factors.
confounders: Customer contract terminations not yet updated in supply chain graphs
Severe market bull runs where high-beta speculative equities outperform defensive names
hypotheses.falsification_test: Collapses during broad supply chain disruptions where supplier gross margins compress across all sectors.
